# All Mathformer reasoning flows

This single-file reference contains every canonical epistemic reasoning-flow profile represented in Mathformer ERFL 0.3. It is generated from the `.rflow` sources, the reasoning-style registry, and the ERFL semantic registry. Edit those sources rather than this file.

Catalog coverage: **9 canonical ERFL profiles**.

This catalogue follows the supplied ERFL 0.2 reference's semantic-document boundary: it contains occurrence graphs and their epistemic interpretations, not implementation schedules. Mathformer's 0.2→0.3 conformance and extension map is recorded in `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`.

An underscore occurrence (`_`) is an unresolved projection gap. A gap-bearing flow is descriptive and non-executable; it cannot license acceptance or an inferred reasoning type.

Repository skill, hook, action, and operational-loop mappings are generated separately in [Reasoning flow materializations](REASONING_FLOW_MATERIALIZATIONS.md). These profiles remain independent workflow abstractions; scope and authority may move between them only through explicit, claim-conserving handoffs.

## Cross-cutting workflow extensions

Two cross-cutting designs refine how workflows expose higher-order change and external knowledge resources. Their ERFL 0.3 semantics are applied in the canonical profiles below:

- [Reflective refinement](REFLECTIVE_REFINEMENT.md) models reasoning change as an immutable baseline/delta/candidate transition with independent testing and governed adoption. This structure is applied to [`trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement`](#trajectory-reflection-and-process-improvement).
- [Knowledge resources in reasoning flows](KNOWLEDGE_RESOURCES_IN_REASONING_FLOWS.md) defines the `@KB`/`@SEARCH`/`@STORE` bindings, inverted access arrows, calibrated persistence arrows, and explicit snapshot/manifest/receipt pattern applied in the profiles below. Resource arrows declare access or guarded effects and never carry epistemic warrant.

## Whole-system predicate map

This generated projection collapses each `steps` expression to its ordered relation signature and named terminal output. Mathformer currently declares no normative cross-program handoffs, so every output ends at `terminal`; the renderer does not infer workflow links from shared skills or handles.

```erfl
map mathformer {
  reasoning::source_grounded_autoformalization -decompose, model, constrain, ground, construct, test, assess, calibrate> output::source_grounded_autoformalization.final_status
       -> output::source_grounded_autoformalization.final_status -> terminal

  reasoning::premise_retrieval_and_verified_reuse -retrieve, ground, assess, calibrate> output::premise_retrieval_and_verified_reuse.reuse_status
       -> output::premise_retrieval_and_verified_reuse.reuse_status -> terminal

  reasoning::formal_proof_discovery -constrain, construct, derive, test, assess, calibrate> output::formal_proof_discovery.proof_status
       -> output::formal_proof_discovery.proof_status -> terminal

  reasoning::executable_symbolic_derivation -model, construct, derive, test, assess, calibrate> output::executable_symbolic_derivation.derivation_status
       -> output::executable_symbolic_derivation.derivation_status -> terminal

  reasoning::physics_derivation_reconstruction -decompose, model, constrain, ground, derive, test, assess, calibrate> output::physics_derivation_reconstruction.physics_status
       -> output::physics_derivation_reconstruction.physics_status -> terminal

  reasoning::adversarial_validation -assess, calibrate> output::adversarial_validation.validation_status
       -> output::adversarial_validation.validation_status -> terminal

  reasoning::critic_driven_recursive_repair -calibrate, revise, test, assess> output::critic_driven_recursive_repair.repair_status
       -> output::critic_driven_recursive_repair.repair_status -> terminal

  reasoning::theory_library_curation -ground, assess, revise, construct, calibrate> output::theory_library_curation.curation_status
       -> output::theory_library_curation.curation_status -> terminal

  reasoning::trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement -revise, construct, test, compare, assess, calibrate> output::trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement.improvement_status
       -> output::trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement.improvement_status -> terminal

}
```

## source_grounded_autoformalization

**Function:** Produce a source-faithful, library-grounded, backend-checked formal artifact.

**Projection status:** `coherent_profile`

**Trust transition:** `source_linked` → `backend_checked_candidate_or_blocker`

**Source references:** `examples/reasoning_flows/source_grounded_autoformalization.rflow`, `skills/REASONING_TYPES.yaml`, `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`

```erfl
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright © 2026 Idiap Research Institute <contact@idiap.ch>
#
# SPDX-FileContributor: Andre Freitas <andre.freitas@idiap.ch>
# Neuro-symbolic AI Group
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Canonical epistemic projection; not an execution trace.
erfl 0.3
reasoning source_grounded_autoformalization {
  goal "produce a source-faithful grounded and checked formal candidate" -> final_status
  steps
    o:O[source::Context->observations::Evidence] -decompose> ...
    s:S[observations::Evidence->structure::Model] -model> ...
    m:M[structure::Model->context::Model] -constrain> ...
    (
      a:A[context::Model->obligations::Obligation]
      & q:Q[context::Model->candidates::Bundle]
    ) -ground> ...
    g:G[
      candidates::Bundle,
      obligations::Obligation,
      context::Model
      -> grounding::Evidence
    ] -construct> ...
    f:F[
      context::Model,
      obligations::Obligation,
      grounding::Evidence
      -> artifact::Bundle
    ] -test> ...
    p:P[artifact::Bundle->execution::Evidence] -assess> ...
    r:R[
      artifact::Bundle,
      execution::Evidence
      -> assessment::Assessment
    ] -calibrate> ...
    e:E[
      artifact::Bundle,
      assessment::Assessment
      -> final_status::Decision
    ]
  on e.accepted => accept
  on e.repair_required => stop
  on e.blocked => stop
}
```

   The steps expression begins as follows: `o` is a **source observation** occurrence (`O`): it consumes `source` (Context) and produces `observations` (Evidence). Its authority ceiling is what the inspected source explicitly contains. It then crosses `-decompose>`: Expose units, dependencies, binders, or structure. The next expression is: `s` is a **structural decomposition** occurrence (`S`): it consumes `observations` (Evidence) and produces `structure` (Model). Its authority ceiling is an explicit structure under the chosen decomposition. It then crosses `-model>`: Construct an explicit semantic or formal model. The next expression is: `m` is a **semantic model construction** occurrence (`M`): it consumes `structure` (Model) and produces `context` (Model). Its authority ceiling is an explicit model, not adequacy of the model. It then crosses `-constrain>`: Use scope, status, or defeaters to narrow admissible outputs. The next expression is: All parallel branches are required and must contribute a conserved handle at the join: Branch 1: `a` is an **abductive hypothesis formation** occurrence (`A`): it consumes `context` (Model) and produces `obligations` (Obligation). Its authority ceiling is candidate explanation or missing premise. Branch 2: `q` is a **retrieval** occurrence (`Q`): it consumes `context` (Model) and produces `candidates` (Bundle). Its authority ceiling is candidate relevance or exact presence, not applicability. It then crosses `-ground>`: Establish a scope-bound alignment or applicability relation. The next expression is: `g` is a **grounding and alignment** occurrence (`G`): it consumes `candidates` (Bundle), `obligations` (Obligation), and `context` (Model) and produces `grounding` (Evidence). Its authority ceiling is scope-bound applicability or meaning preservation. It then crosses `-construct>`: Materialize a candidate formal or executable artifact. The next expression is: `f` is a **constructive formalization** occurrence (`F`): it consumes `context` (Model), `obligations` (Obligation), and `grounding` (Evidence) and produces `artifact` (Bundle). Its authority ceiling is candidate artifact with unresolved validation obligations. It then crosses `-test>`: Make a claim or artifact the object of falsification or critical assessment. The next expression is: `p` is an **execution, probing, and falsification search** occurrence (`P`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and produces `execution` (Evidence). Its authority ceiling is observed behavior or counterexample within the declared scope. It then crosses `-assess>`: Evaluate cited evidence against named criteria. The next expression is: `r` is a **critical assessment and refutational verdict** occurrence (`R`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and `execution` (Evidence) and produces `assessment` (Assessment). Its authority ceiling is criterion-scoped assessment, refutation, or bounded nonrefutation. It then crosses `-calibrate>`: Update status without creating a new substantive claim. The next expression is: `e` is an **evidential calibration and epistemic governance** occurrence (`E`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and `assessment` (Assessment) and produces `final_status` (Decision). Its authority ceiling is status or disposition only; no new substantive claim.

12. `on e.accepted => accept`

   When `e` (evidential calibration and epistemic governance) reports **accepted**, the profile accepts the calibrated result for workflow purposes. Acceptance contributes no new object-level warrant.

13. `on e.repair_required => stop`

   When `e` (evidential calibration and epistemic governance) reports **repair required**, the profile stops. Stopping records a disposition; it does not prove the negation or impossibility of the goal.

14. `on e.blocked => stop`

   When `e` (evidential calibration and epistemic governance) reports **blocked**, the profile stops. Stopping records a disposition; it does not prove the negation or impossibility of the goal.

15. `}`

   Ends the `source_grounded_autoformalization` definition.

## premise_retrieval_and_verified_reuse

**Function:** Reuse an existing result without confusing relevance with validity.

**Projection status:** `coherent_profile`

**Trust transition:** `unresolved_concept_or_result` → `snapshot_bound_verified_reuse_candidate_or_explicit_gap`

**Source references:** `examples/reasoning_flows/premise_retrieval_and_verified_reuse.rflow`, `skills/REASONING_TYPES.yaml`, `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`

```erfl
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright © 2026 Idiap Research Institute <contact@idiap.ch>
#
# SPDX-FileContributor: Andre Freitas <andre.freitas@idiap.ch>
# Neuro-symbolic AI Group
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Canonical epistemic projection; not an execution trace.
erfl 0.3
@KB kb0 connect(file("MathformerKB"))
reasoning premise_retrieval_and_verified_reuse {
  goal "produce a verified reuse candidate or an explicit gap" -> reuse_status
  steps
    (
      s:S[request::Context->query::Model<KnowledgeQuery>]
      & o:O[
        kb0,
        kb_version::Constraint
        -> kb_snapshot::Bundle<KnowledgeBaseSnapshot>,
        kb_manifest::Evidence<SnapshotManifest>
      ]
    ) -retrieve> ...
    q:Q[
      query::Model<KnowledgeQuery>,
      kb_snapshot::Bundle<KnowledgeBaseSnapshot>,
      kb_manifest::Evidence<SnapshotManifest>
      -> candidates::Bundle<RetrievalCandidate>,
      retrieval_receipt::Evidence<RetrievalReceipt>
    ] -ground> ...
    g:G[
      candidates::Bundle<RetrievalCandidate>,
      query::Model<KnowledgeQuery>
      -> alignment::Evidence<GroundingLink>
    ] -assess> ...
    r:R[
      candidates::Bundle<RetrievalCandidate>,
      alignment::Evidence<GroundingLink>
      -> assessment::Assessment
    ] -calibrate> ...
    e:E[
      candidates::Bundle<RetrievalCandidate>,
      assessment::Assessment,
      kb_manifest::Evidence<SnapshotManifest>,
      retrieval_receipt::Evidence<RetrievalReceipt>
      -> reuse_status::Decision
    ]
  o <-query- kb0
  on e.reuse_candidate => accept
  on e.explicit_gap => stop
  on e.stale_knowledge_snapshot => stop
  on e.knowledge_resource_unavailable => stop
}
```

## formal_proof_discovery

**Function:** Derive a conclusion and retain authoritative formal proof evidence.

**Projection status:** `coherent_profile`

**Trust transition:** `formal_claim_candidate` → `proof_checked_artifact_or_search_failure`

**Source references:** `examples/reasoning_flows/formal_proof_discovery.rflow`, `skills/REASONING_TYPES.yaml`, `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`

```erfl
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright © 2026 Idiap Research Institute <contact@idiap.ch>
#
# SPDX-FileContributor: Andre Freitas <andre.freitas@idiap.ch>
# Neuro-symbolic AI Group
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Canonical epistemic projection; not an execution trace.
erfl 0.3
@SEARCH search0 connect(file("MathformerKB"))
reasoning formal_proof_discovery {
  goal "produce a proof-checked claim or preserved proof obstruction" -> proof_status
  steps
    m:M[theorem_context::Context->semantic_model::Model] -constrain> ...
    (
      q:Q[semantic_model::Model,search0->premises::Bundle]
      & a:A[semantic_model::Model->route::Claim]
    ) -construct> ...
    f:F[
      premises::Bundle,
      route::Claim
      -> proof_candidate::Bundle
    ] -derive> ...
    d:D[
      proof_candidate::Bundle,
      premises::Bundle
      -> claim::Claim
    ] -test> ...
    p:P[claim::Claim->checker_evidence::Evidence] -assess> ...
    r:R[
      claim::Claim,
      checker_evidence::Evidence
      -> assessment::Assessment
    ] -calibrate> ...
    e:E[
      claim::Claim,
      assessment::Assessment
      -> proof_status::Decision
    ]
  q <-search- search0
  on e.proof_checked => accept
  on e.repair_required => stop
  on e.blocked => stop
}
```

**Source references:** `examples/reasoning_flows/critic_driven_recursive_repair.rflow`, `skills/REASONING_TYPES.yaml`, `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`

```erfl

# Neuro-symbolic AI Group

erfl 0.3
reasoning critic_driven_recursive_repair {
  goal "produce a calibrated artifact assessment after bounded repair"
    -> repair_status
  steps
    r:R[artifact::Bundle,evidence::Evidence->assessment::Assessment] -calibrate> ...
    e:E[
      artifact::Bundle,
      assessment::Assessment
      -> repair_status::Decision
    ]
  repeat 1..4 [
    x:X[artifact::Bundle,assessment::Assessment->repair::Plan] -revise> ...
    f:F[
      artifact::Bundle,
      repair::Plan
      -> revised_artifact::Bundle
    ] -test> ...
    p:P[revised_artifact::Bundle->revised_evidence::Evidence] -assess> ...
    r2:R[
      revised_artifact::Bundle,
      revised_evidence::Evidence
      -> revised_assessment::Assessment
    ] -calibrate> ...
    e2:E[
      revised_artifact::Bundle,
      revised_assessment::Assessment
      -> iteration_status::Decision
    ]
  ] until e2.accepted measure unresolved_findings
  on e.accepted => accept
  on e.repair_required => stop
  on e.blocked => stop
}
```

   Sets the epistemic objective to “produce a calibrated artifact assessment after bounded repair” and requires the terminal calibration occurrence to produce `repair_status`. Producing a decision handle does not itself establish the substantive claim.

11. **Steps expression** (source lines 12–18)

   ```erfl
     steps
       r:R[artifact::Bundle,evidence::Evidence->assessment::Assessment] -calibrate> ...
       e:E[
         artifact::Bundle,
         assessment::Assessment
         -> repair_status::Decision
       ]
   ```

   The steps expression begins as follows: `r` is a **critical assessment and refutational verdict** occurrence (`R`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and `evidence` (Evidence) and produces `assessment` (Assessment). Its authority ceiling is criterion-scoped assessment, refutation, or bounded nonrefutation. It then crosses `-calibrate>`: Update status without creating a new substantive claim. The next expression is: `e` is an **evidential calibration and epistemic governance** occurrence (`E`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and `assessment` (Assessment) and produces `repair_status` (Decision). Its authority ceiling is status or disposition only; no new substantive claim.

   ```erfl

       x:X[artifact::Bundle,assessment::Assessment->repair::Plan] -revise> ...
       f:F[
         artifact::Bundle,
         repair::Plan
         -> revised_artifact::Bundle
       ] -test> ...
       p:P[revised_artifact::Bundle->revised_evidence::Evidence] -assess> ...
       r2:R[
         revised_artifact::Bundle,
         revised_evidence::Evidence
         -> revised_assessment::Assessment
       ] -calibrate> ...
       e2:E[
         revised_artifact::Bundle,
         revised_assessment::Assessment
         -> iteration_status::Decision
       ]

   ```

   Runs a bounded repair body at least 1 and at most 4 times. It may terminate when `e2.accepted` holds, and it must track the observable progress measure `unresolved_findings`. The steps expression begins as follows: `x` is a **diagnosis and revision** occurrence (`X`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and `assessment` (Assessment) and produces `repair` (Plan). Its authority ceiling is diagnosis, repair proposal, or new revision identity. It then crosses `-revise>`: Start a new diagnosis, hypothesis, model, transfer, artifact, or derivation identity. The next expression is: `f` is a **constructive formalization** occurrence (`F`): it consumes `artifact` (Bundle) and `repair` (Plan) and produces `revised_artifact` (Bundle). Its authority ceiling is candidate artifact with unresolved validation obligations. It then crosses `-test>`: Make a claim or artifact the object of falsification or critical assessment. The next expression is: `p` is an **execution, probing, and falsification search** occurrence (`P`): it consumes `revised_artifact` (Bundle) and produces `revised_evidence` (Evidence). Its authority ceiling is observed behavior or counterexample within the declared scope. It then crosses `-assess>`: Evaluate cited evidence against named criteria. The next expression is: `r2` is a **critical assessment and refutational verdict** occurrence (`R`): it consumes `revised_artifact` (Bundle) and `revised_evidence` (Evidence) and produces `revised_assessment` (Assessment). Its authority ceiling is criterion-scoped assessment, refutation, or bounded nonrefutation. It then crosses `-calibrate>`: Update status without creating a new substantive claim. The next expression is: `e2` is an **evidential calibration and epistemic governance** occurrence (`E`): it consumes `revised_artifact` (Bundle) and `revised_assessment` (Assessment) and produces `iteration_status` (Decision). Its authority ceiling is status or disposition only; no new substantive claim.

13. `on e.accepted => accept`

   When `e` (evidential calibration and epistemic governance) reports **accepted**, the profile accepts the calibrated result for workflow purposes. Acceptance contributes no new object-level warrant.

14. `on e.repair_required => stop`

   When `e` (evidential calibration and epistemic governance) reports **repair required**, the profile stops. Stopping records a disposition; it does not prove the negation or impossibility of the goal.

15. `on e.blocked => stop`

   When `e` (evidential calibration and epistemic governance) reports **blocked**, the profile stops. Stopping records a disposition; it does not prove the negation or impossibility of the goal.

16. `}`

   Ends the `critic_driven_recursive_repair` definition.

## theory_library_curation

**Function:** Turn reusable candidates into coherent, provenance-bearing library knowledge.

**Projection status:** `coherent_profile`

**Trust transition:** `reusable_candidate` → `accepted_curated_entry_or_repair_plan`

**Source references:** `examples/reasoning_flows/theory_library_curation.rflow`, `skills/REASONING_TYPES.yaml`, `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`

```erfl
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright © 2026 Idiap Research Institute <contact@idiap.ch>
#
# SPDX-FileContributor: Andre Freitas <andre.freitas@idiap.ch>
# Neuro-symbolic AI Group
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Canonical epistemic projection; not an execution trace.
erfl 0.3
@KB kb0 connect(file("MathformerKB"))
reasoning theory_library_curation {
  goal "produce a policy-bound curation disposition" -> curation_status
  steps
    q:Q[curation_request::Context->candidates::Bundle] -ground> ...
    g:G[candidates::Bundle->grounding::Evidence] -assess> ...
    r:R[
      candidates::Bundle,
      grounding::Evidence
      -> assessment::Assessment
    ] -revise> ...
    x:X[
      candidates::Bundle,
      assessment::Assessment
      -> repair::Plan
    ] -construct> ...
    f:F[
      candidates::Bundle,
      repair::Plan
      -> curated_candidate::Bundle
    ] -calibrate> ...
    e:E[
      curated_candidate::Bundle,
      assessment::Assessment
      -> curation_status::Decision
    ]
  e -persist-> kb0
  on e.accepted => accept
  on e.repair_required => stop
  on e.rejected => stop
}
```

## trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement

**Function:** Propose and independently test an immutable reasoning revision without weakening prior successful behavior.

**Projection status:** `coherent_profile`

**Trust transition:** `observed_workflow_trajectory` → `tested_scoped_reasoning_revision_or_retained_baseline`

**Source references:** `examples/reasoning_flows/trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement.rflow`, `skills/REASONING_TYPES.yaml`, `skills/control/reasoning-flow-language/references/erfl-0.3.json`

```erfl
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright © 2026 Idiap Research Institute <contact@idiap.ch>
#
# SPDX-FileContributor: Andre Freitas <andre.freitas@idiap.ch>
# Neuro-symbolic AI Group
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Canonical epistemic projection; not an execution trace.
erfl 0.3
reasoning trajectory_reflection_and_process_improvement {
  goal "produce a tested disposition over an immutable reasoning revision" -> improvement_status
  steps
    l0:L[
      baseline_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      baseline_evidence::Evidence<ReasoningTrajectory>,
      refinement_goal::Goal,
      evaluation_cases::Bundle<EvaluationCase>,
      evaluation_contract::Constraint<RefinementContract>,
      trust_anchor::Constraint<AdoptionPolicy>
      -> reflective_assessment::Assessment
    ] -revise> ...
    x:X[
      baseline_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      reflective_assessment::Assessment,
      evaluation_contract::Constraint<RefinementContract>,
      trust_anchor::Constraint<AdoptionPolicy>
      -> proposed_delta::Delta<ReasoningSpecification>
    ] -construct> ...
    f:F[
      baseline_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      proposed_delta::Delta<ReasoningSpecification>
      -> candidate_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      revision_record::Relation<ReasoningRevision>
    ] -test> ...
    p:P[
      candidate_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      evaluation_cases::Bundle<EvaluationCase>,
      evaluation_contract::Constraint<RefinementContract>
      -> candidate_evidence::Evidence<ReasoningTrajectory>
    ] -compare> ...
    l1:L[
      baseline_evidence::Evidence<ReasoningTrajectory>,
      candidate_evidence::Evidence<ReasoningTrajectory>,
      evaluation_contract::Constraint<RefinementContract>
      -> comparative_assessment::Assessment
    ] -assess> ...
    r:R[
      candidate_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      revision_record::Relation<ReasoningRevision>,
      comparative_assessment::Assessment,
      trust_anchor::Constraint<AdoptionPolicy>
      -> adoption_assessment::Assessment
    ] -calibrate> ...
    e:E[
      baseline_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      candidate_reasoning::Model<ReasoningSpecification>,
      revision_record::Relation<ReasoningRevision>,
      comparative_assessment::Assessment,
      adoption_assessment::Assessment,
      trust_anchor::Constraint<AdoptionPolicy>
      -> improvement_status::Decision
    ]
  on e.adopted_for_scope => accept
  on e.retained_as_experiment => stop
  on e.rejected => stop
  on e.blocked => stop
}
```
